cf_2_a.canonical_raw:
Compute every named player final score. Among players tied at the final positive maximumM, the winner is the player whose running score first reached at leastM earliest. Output the winner name.

Input: n; n chronological records name score. Name is1..32 lowercase letters; score is in[-1000,1000]. All scores begin at0. At least one final score is positive. Output: one winning name.

Benchmark constraints: n<=35. All counts and indices are integers. Input satisfies the stated structural promises.

Input: n k with1<=k<=n; n integer temperatures in[1,5000]. Output: one real number with absolute error<10^-6.
